title: AgentTeamLand ATL Config
description: Schema for atl-config.json — the user/project-tunable configuration layer for the atl CLI. Lives at ~/.atl/config.json (global) and ./.atl/config.json (project). Effective config is global-merged-with-project, with project overriding. Holds 9 user-tunable keys (see properties below). Decision context: workspace .claude/docs/atl-config-system.md (decided 2026-05-06).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version number (monotonic integer). Bumped on any field add / remove / rename / type change / enum change / default semantic change. Current: 1. atl auto-migrates older versions silently with a backup at ~/.atl/config.json.bak.v{N}.

locale.description: User-facing locale for atl CLI output (welcome flow, prompts, error messages). v1 only ships English; the cli-localization brainstorm will widen this with the actual translation infrastructure. 'tr' is accepted in the schema for forward-compatibility but currently behaves as 'en' until cli-localization ships.

autoUpdate.description: Auto-update behavior settings (atl update + atl session-start hooks). Disable individual hooks or tune throttling here.

sessionStartEnabled.description: Whether the SessionStart hook runs atl session-start (cached repo pull + previous-transcript marker scan + atl-version check). Set to false to disable session-start auto-update entirely.

promptSubmitEnabled.description: Whether the UserPromptSubmit hook runs atl update (cache repo pull, throttled). Set to false to disable per-message auto-update.

throttleMinutes.description: Throttle window for the UserPromptSubmit auto-update. atl update --silent-if-clean will skip if the previous run was within this many minutes. Default 30. Lower values (e.g. 5) update more aggressively at the cost of more git-fetch traffic.

selfCheckEnabled.description: Whether atl session-start checks the GitHub releases API for a newer atl binary. Set to false to silence the upgrade-available banner (e.g. on machines where brew/scoop/winget upgrades are managed centrally).

selfCheckHours.description: How often (in hours) atl session-start polls the GitHub releases API for a newer atl binary. Default 24. The check is rate-limited regardless of this value via the cache stamp at ~/.atl/cache/last-self-check.

autoScanEnabled.description: Whether atl session-start scans previous-session transcripts for <!-- learning --> markers and reports them in the new session's additionalContext. Set to false to opt out of the auto-trigger loop entirely (markers still accumulate in transcripts; manual /save-learnings invocation still works).

firstRunLookbackDays.description: On the first scan for a project (no state file yet), how many days of transcripts to consider. Default 7. Subsequent scans use the per-project lastProcessedAt timestamp from ~/.atl/state/learning-capture-state.json.

markerBulletCap.description: Cap on the number of brainstorm-active marker bullets pinned to a scope's CLAUDE.md / README. When more than this many brainstorms are active in a single scope, the oldest are dropped from the marker block (the brainstorm files themselves are never deleted). Default 8.
